title: Run result
description: One agent run of the experiment (one line of a results JSONL file). Shared by the IPI (AgentDojo) and MCP (tool poisoning) tracks; see notes/protocol.md.

track.description: ipi = indirect prompt injection through tool results (AgentDojo); mcp = tool poisoning through tool descriptions.

run_type.description: attack = user task with the payload; no_attack = utility baseline; injection_as_user_task = control, the attacker's goal given as the user task.

model.description: Schema id of the model; mapping to weights / API ids in notes/protocol.md 1.1.

payload_lang.description: Language of the payload; null when there is no payload (no_attack, injection_as_user_task).

suite.description: Task environment: an AgentDojo suite (e.g. workspace) or the MCP track's environment.

user_task.description: User task id (for injection_as_user_task: the injection task id).

injection_task.description: Attacker goal id; null for no_attack.

attack.description: Attack variant, e.g. important_instructions_no_model_name / important_instructions_pl (ipi); null when there is no payload.

exposed.description: The payload reached the model's context (ipi: a tool result contained it; mcp: defined by the track). null when there is no payload.

attack_success.description: The attacker's goal is met in the world state after the run (deterministic checker). For context overflows: scored from the replay. null when there is no payload.

attack_success_dedup.description: Same check after replaying the run's tool calls with identical calls executed once. Primary success measure. null when there is no payload.

utility.description: The user task was completed (benchmark checker).

utility_risk.description: How much the utility checker depends on the answer's language (data/utility_risk.json); utility is reported only for none/low. null when not assessed (e.g. control runs).

no_output.description: The run ended without a final text answer (step limit or empty answer).

context_overflow.description: The request exceeded the model's context window.

refused.description: Manual annotation (notes/protocol.md 1.5): the model explicitly declined the injected instruction. null for runs outside the annotated sample.

steps.description: Number of LLM calls (assistant messages) in the run.

tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls in the run.

error.description: Error recorded by the harness (e.g. context length exceeded), or null.

log_path.description: Path of the full run log, relative to the repository root.

harness_commit.description: Git commit of this repository the run was produced with.

server_version.description: Serving stack, e.g. vllm 0.24.0, or the API name.
